sweptClasses.sample: install-kimi.sh copy_skills prunes the deployed skill directories BEFORE copying, so an install that goes on to deploy nothing still removes what was there. Confirmed pre-existing by a mutation repro that took a target from 17 skills to 0; the loss is the kaola-namespaced set only and is regenerable by re-running, and with this bundle's tree-root fix the path is near-unreachable because heal-or-abort now precedes the copy. This bundle made an existing SILENT loss loud; it did not create it.
